title: Choose September spending for reseller inquiries
brief: Cedarline has three running advertising campaigns bringing in very different reseller inquiries. Decide their September spending and sales support by September 1, 2026. Compare at least two practical choices using recorded spending, customer needs, application papers and ordering history through August 31, 2026. Explain what the linked records can tell us and where they leave uncertainty. Keep spending within the desk's budget and protect existing application, service and catalog work. Finish with a written decision, checked calculations, matching advertising settings and named customer follow-ups. Give clear reasons and conditions for reconsidering any campaign you pause or leave unsupported.
